headline: OAK @ LAA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is OAK 4.48 at LAA 4.70, with a projected total of 9.18. Batter research is strongest for Nick Kurtz, Carlos Cortes, Shea Langeliers, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Lawrence Butler because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
